caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded ceramic pot placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pot is uniformly brown in color, with subtle variations in shading to indicate curvature, light, and shadow, suggesting a reflective surface. The rim at the top is slightly flared and oval-shaped, revealing a dark interior. There are lighter highlights on the pot's surface, especially on the upper left area, and no additional objects or decorations are present. In the bottom right corner, there is a small red star and the text "M.A.R.S. 1939" written in red.
title: Stone Fruit Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
